Game Overview

Nail Doctor is a educational title where become the Nail Doctor and dive into the intriguing world of foot care. Treat a variety of intriguing nail ailments using intuitive mouse controls. With colorful graphics and engagingly simple mechanics, it's your job to heal and celebrate every successful treatment with a fun mini-game!
